{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Dress: A-line wedding-guest dress with a V-neckline, soft flutter sleeves, a defined waist and a flowing skirt, midi length just below the calf, in deep jade green #3F6B5E, lightweight silk crepe with a fine lining

Shoes: Block-heel sandals with a slim ankle strap, heel about 6 cm, in warm nude-gold #C9A27E, soft leather with a satin finish

Clutch: Small envelope clutch in champagne #D9C3A0, silk satin

Earrings: Teardrop earrings with a slim drop, in polished gold #C8A24A, metal

Bracelet: Thin, smooth cuff, in polished gold #C8A24A, metal

Why this outfit works: A silk crepe dress in a formal midi cut suits the dress code for a close family member at her sister's wedding, and it stays light and breathable for an August afternoon ceremony outdoors. Deep jade echoes her gray-green eyes and sets off her golden hair and warm skin, while avoiding white, ivory and anything that competes with the bride. The flared skirt moves easily on grass and at the restaurant afterward, and the block heel keeps her steady on soft ground. The warm gold accents and the champagne clutch pull the look together and carry it smoothly from daylight into the evening."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2539,"output_tokens":927},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
